title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-30
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording that’s a bit muffled but captures an intense Dark Star and a standout Born Cross‑Eyed → Spanish Jam, though the overall mix is uneven.
ai_review.review: The show delivers several high points – a gorgeous Dark Star, an incendiary Born Cross‑Eyed → Spanish Jam suite, and sparkling moments in Morning Dew and China Cat Sunrise. The SBD source is listenable but suffers from muffled, distant tones and inconsistent levels that dull the impact of some jams. Overall it’s a solid early‑68 performance worth hearing despite its technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split: many praise key performances (Dark Star, Born Cross‑Eyed → Spanish Jam) while noting muffled, rough sound and occasional flat playing, leading to a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muffled and distant with an airy quality; levels vary from very rough to just rough, making the mix uneven but still listenable.

poor_songs: The Other One (sloppy in one review)
Dark Star (short and one‑dimensional for some)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong transitions – The Other One segues into Dark Star, followed by a seamless Born Cross‑Eyed → Spanish Jam suite; overall flow is cohesive despite occasional flat spots.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo work gets high marks (Morning Dew, Dark Star) but his playing is described as hit‑or‑miss and the tone varies with the rough mix.
